title: Gunslinger Girl: Il Teatrino OVA
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 78812 and TMDB show 31731. Anime-Lists leaves episodeoffset empty on this season 0 node, which places no regular episode; offset 0 places them. AniDB episode 1-2 ("ヴェネツィアの光, 心の闇" (The Light of Venice, the Darkness of the Heart) to "ファンタズマ" (Fantasma)) are TVDB S0E1 "The Light of Venice, The Darkness of the Heart" to TVDB S0E2 "Fantasma"; AniDB S1 "Interview of Masaya Matsukaze (Hirscher`s voice)" has no TVDB episode (its default TVDB S0E1 is "The Light of Venice, The Darkness of the Heart", another item) and no TMDB episode (its default TMDB S0E1 is "The Light of Venice, The Darkness of the Heart", another item).
